title: filenode-server: check blob exists on FileNode/copy
description: From audit JMAP-t8ej.5 (filenode-19 finding brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-filenode#6). FileNode/set create checks backend.blob_exists (crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/filenode.rs:634) but FileNode/copy does not, so a cross-account copy stores the source account's blobId unchecked (memory.rs:989-999) and the destination may not have the blob. Fix: for File nodes, call blob_exists on the destination account before copy_object; missing -> invalidProperties naming blobId (RFC 8620 /copy semantics; blob must exist in the target account). Test: cross-account copy of a File whose blob is absent in the destination -> notCreated invalidProperties blobId; present -> created. If upstream later adopts 'server copies the blob', replace with a backend copy_blob hook (separate bead).
